title: CCL Test Results Format
description: Structured JSON output for CCL implementation test results. Contains raw per-test outcomes; consumers derive summaries, metrics, and breakdowns.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this document was generated

tests.description: Individual test outcomes with full tag metadata for consumer-side aggregation

ImplementationInfo.title: ImplementationInfo
ImplementationInfo.description: Identity and capability declaration of the implementation under test

implementedFunctions.description: Functions with actual implementations. Consumers use this to classify functions as implemented vs todo vs unsupported — it cannot be derived from test outcomes alone.

TestSuiteInfo.title: TestSuiteInfo
TestSuiteInfo.description: Information about the test suite version used

version.description: Test suite version string (from .version file in test data)

totalTests.description: Total number of tests in the suite. Should equal tests.length.

TestOutcome.title: TestOutcome
TestOutcome.description: Individual test result with full tag metadata

validation.description: CCL function being validated (e.g. parse, build_hierarchy)

behaviors.description: Behavior tags from the test case

features.description: Feature tags from the test case

variants.description: Variant tags from the test case

reason.description: Skip or todo reason (raw string — consumers categorize as needed)
